job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using generative AI models such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI technology into existing systems and applications.
Develop data pipelines to extract insights from large datasets using Python programming language.
Troubleshoot complex issues related to AI model performance, data quality, and system integration.

Job Requirements :

5-8 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in GANs, VAEs, LangGraph, etc.
Experience working on retrieval augmented generation tasks such as text summarization, question answering, etc.
